spans.s: Ratā, wife of Prajāpati^2 and mother of the Vasu Ahar. § 116 (Vasu, pl.): I, 66, 2584.

Rati^1 (“Delight, Lust,” personif.), a goddess, wife of Kāma. § 117 (Aṃśāvat.): I, 66, 2597 (wife of Kāma).--§ 270 (Brahmasabhāv.): II, 11, 459 (in the palace of Brahmán).-§ 350 (Nalopākhyānap.): III, 68, 2665 (Manmathasya Rºīm iva).
Rati^2, an Apsaras. § 731b (Ashṭāvakra-Diksaṃv.): XIII, 19, 1425 (danced in the palace of Kubera).
Ratiguṇa, a Devagandharva. § 102 (Aṃśāvat.): I, 65, 2555 (sixth son of Prādhā).
Rātri (“Night,” personif.). § 135 (Śakuntalop.): I, 74, 3017.--§ 555 (Indravijaya): V, 13, 425 (devīṃ).--§ 615u (Skanda): IX, 45, 2517 (ºy-ahanī, came to the investiture of Skanda). Cf. Niśā^2.
